Firefox sets multiple [[How to set the home page|home pages]] when you separate each address with a pipe character (|) or vertical bar. This feature may lead to problems when an individual home page address contains a pipe character.

Here's how to fix it:
{for not fx61}
# [[T:optionspreferences]]
# Select the {menu General} panel.
# In the '''Home Page''' text box, replace all pipes (|) with '''%7C'''.
# [[T:closeOptionsPreferences]]
{/for}
{for fx61}
{for not fx152}
# [[T:optionspreferences]]
# Select the {menu Home} panel.
# In the '''Homepage and new windows''' text box for '''Custom URLs…''', replace all pipes (|) with '''%7C'''.
# [[T:closeOptionsPreferences]]
{/for}
{for fx152}
#[[T:optionspreferences]]
#Select the {menu Home and startup} page on the left.
#In the {menu Homepage} section, click on the text box for '''Custom URLs…''', in the {menu New Windows} section, and replace all pipes (|) with %7C.
#;[[Image:fx152homepage]]
{/for}
{/for}

{note}'''Tip:''' If removing the pipe character doesn't solve the problem, add-ons or malware might be causing this behavior. Try [[Refresh Firefox - reset add-ons and settings | refreshing Firefox]] to remove add-ons without erasing your browsing information and bookmarks.{/note}
